Tags: Health, HealthRegen

[Passive] Colossal Consumption: (0s) per target If an enemy champion is nearby for a few seconds, your next Attack against them deals 70 plus 6% of your max Health as bonus physical damage and grants 10% of the damage as max Health.

[Passive] Goliath: For each 1000 max Health, gain 3% increased size, up to 30%.
